end.summary:
Asha practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya identified a cube in a die and a cylinder in a candle.
Aditya identified circle-shaped flat faces and stated that a cylinder has 2 flat faces and 1 curved face.
Aditya identified a cricket ball as a sphere.
Aditya said an upside-down party cap changes from a cone to a bowl shape; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised matching cube, cylinder, cone, and sphere to familiar objects. They used the cylinder’s flat and curved faces to explain their answer and connected a ball with a sphere. Aditya mixed up a cone’s name when it was turned upside down, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, turn a cone-shaped object around and ask, “Does its shape name change?”
